pages.title: Pixel Tracker Module
pages.text: A qubit-array sensor that records the exact path of every charged particle crossing it. Each pixel is a qubit that flips when a particle passes, and the trail of flipped pixels traces a track. It is flat, cold and delicate.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I needed to see particle tracks, not just flashes. In the Femto Fabricator I laid Qubits and Quantum Dots on a Cherenkov Wafer with Superconducting Solder. Every passing particle flipped a line of pixels.
